programme.title: Video Art
programme.desc: Street art, performances, digital art... Because the new forms of Art and their invigorating character, even iconoclastic, have been able to attract a new public until now refractory to go inside the interior of our beautiful museums.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: « J’envie les Japonais », écrivait Van Gogh à son frère, Théo. Grâce à l’exposition sur laquelle est basé ce film, « Van Gogh et le Japon », au musée Van Gogh d’Amsterdam, on comprend pourquoi. Bien que Vincent van Gogh n’ait jamais visité le Japon, il reste le pays qui a eu le plus d’influence sur lui et son œuvre. En se rendant dans les galeries d’art japonais à Paris et en créant sa propre image du Japon après des recherches approfondies, des collections d’estampes et de longues discussions avec d’autres artistes, la découverte des œuvres japonaises entraîna la carrière de Van Gogh dans une nouvelle direction très excitante.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Né en 1866 à Moscou, Wassily Kandinsky est considéré comme l’un des artistes les plus importants du 20ème siècle. Il est notamment le fondateur de l’art abstrait. Il quitte la Russie pour aller en Allemagne lorsqu’il devient professeur à Bauhaus en 1922, et s’installe par la suite en France en 1933, laissant derrière lui un travail très abondant. Vous allez re-découvrir ses créations les plus emblématiques, principalement exposé au Centre Pompidou à Paris.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: S’inspirant de personnages familiers, Gustave Courbet a érigé les gens simples au rang de la peinture d’histoire… Il a aussi su mettre le corps féminin à l’honneur avec sa célèbre Origine du monde… Si son audace, associée à un naturalisme sans concession, a bien souvent fait scandale, c’est elle qui a fait sa notoriété. Avec des tableaux tels que Le sommeil, L’enterrement à Ornans ou bien L’atelier du peintre, cette exposition vous dévoile l’œuvre du chef de file du courant réaliste. Bonne visite !

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.sub-title: Les nuances de couleur à la campagne
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:movement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparingand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Little Sketches
programme.desc: In 64 fun episodes, Gia-Haï Phan teaches you all the sketching techniques you need.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: La Pyramide de Djoser, la plus ancienne pyramide égyptienne - 2 600 AJC révèle sans doute les tous premiers pas de ce qu'on appelle l'architecture, comme pratique savante, distincte de la simple construction. Le lieu où s'opère cette coupure est un monument funéraire, où la fonction symbolique prend le pas sur le simple usage. L'architecture à sa naissance s'affirme d'emblée non pas comme fonction mais comme signe. A trente kilomètres au sud du Caire, à l'est la vallée du Nil, Saqqarah fut la nécropole de Memphis, la première capitale de l'ancienne Égypte, dont il ne reste rien sauf cet immense cimetière dominé par les soixante mètres de la pyramide à degrés de Djoser.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Without Camille Pissarro, there is no Impressionist movement. He is rightfully known as the father of Impressionism.It was a dramatic path that Pissarro followed, and throughout it all he wrote extensively to his family. It is through these intimate and revealing letters that this gripping film reveals Pissarro’s life and work.Born in the West Indies, Pissarro found his passion in paint as a young man in Paris, and by the age of 43 had corralled a group of enthusiastic artists into a new collective. Their first show was scorned by the critics, but the group had acquired a new name: the Impressionists. For the next 40 years Pissarro was the driving force behind what has today become the world’s favourite artistic movement.The Ashmolean Museum has a long tradition of excellence. As the UK’s first ever public museum (it opened its doors in May 1683) it houses a wonderfully rich collection, including the remarkable Pissarro archive. With exclusive access to most extensive archive of.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Après deux ans d’exposition itinérante, en 2015 "La Jeune Fille à la perle” est retournée au musée Mauritshuis de La Haye. Du haut de ses 350 ans, l’éternelle Jeune Fille a toujours su conserver son aura de mystère et son charme. La preuve, c’est le nombre de curieux (1,2 millions) qui ont accouru pour l’apercevoir lors de son séjour au Japon. Le documentaire cherche à découvrir les nombreuses énigmes de cet extraordinaire tableau et de son créateur mystérieux - Vermeer. Qui était cette fille ? Pourquoi et comment Vermeer a-t-il peint ce tableau ? Venez voyager dans le temps pour découvrir Johannes Vermeer, visiter le charmant musée de La Haye et répondre à toutes ces questions.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: David Hockney à la Royal Academy of Arts
programme.desc: David Hockney, généralement considéré comme l’un des artistes britanniques les plus populaires, connaît un succès mondial grâce à ses expositions à Londres, New York, Paris et ailleurs qui attirent des millions de spectateurs. Devenu récemment octogénaire, Hockney ne semble pas avoir l’intention de lever le pied ni de perdre son audace légendaire. Ce film révèle des interviews intimes et inédites et se concentre sur deux expositions à succès ayant eu lieu en 2012 et 2016 à la Royal Academy of Arts Londres. Le réalisateur Phil Grabsky a bénéficié d’un accès privilégié pour célébrer sur grand écran ce génie créatif du XXIe siècle.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: In no way was Pierre Bonnard destined to be a painter. However, he became one of the pillars of the Nabi Movement. His work, more closely linked to emotions than to realism, is impossible to classify. It is punctuated with huge sunny landscapes, of both the Mediterranean and Normandy, with interior scenes, with nudes and self portraits. This exhibition offers you ten of the artist’s greatest paintings, such as his famous “Workshop with Mimosa” and his “Nude in Bathtub”. Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Between 1883 and 1926 Claude Monet lived in a house at Giverny where he created a flower garden and a water garden, which provided the inspiration for his series of paintings known as the “Water Lilies”. The “Water-Lily Pond” portrays this garden, with its water lilies and the Japanese bridge in the background. In the series of eight large canvases on the theme, housed in the Musée de l’Orangerie in Paris, Monet introduces variations in light according to the hour of the day.Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip - Season 1
programme.desc: Comedy legend Jennifer Saunders and best pal, top actress Patricia Potter take to the road on a humdinger of a trip. Joined by veteran antiquers Phillip Serrell and Mark Stacey they shop in Berkshire, Hampshire and Oxfordshire before heading for an auction in Greenwich, London. Jennifer and Phil detour to hear about Fred Karno, the man credited with inventing slapstick comedy. While Patricia and Mark learn how a surgeon from Reading used his incredible sense of smell to successfully treat soldiers injured in World War One.And, Phil gets custard pied – what’s not to love?

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip - Season 1
programme.desc: Aujourd’hui, on relève le piquant avec les gastronomes gourmets Tony Singh et Cyrus Todiwala. Les chefs sont accompagnés de David Harper et Natasha Raskin.Partant de Dundee, ils descendent la côte est de l’Écosse jusqu’au village de Rosewell, dans le Midlothian, pour une vente aux enchères. Cyrus démontre un talent certain pour négocier, tandis que Tony n’hésite pas à afficher ses prix.Tony découvre pourquoi une ville écossaise a été le foyer de nombreux millionnaires, et Cyrus prend ses marques en mer en apprenant pourquoi Anstruther était un port de pêche clé au XIXe siècle.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip - Season 1
programme.sub-title: Tanni Grey Thompson and Jade Jones
programme.desc: Aujourd'hui, nous sommes dans le Nord-Est de l'Angleterre avec les grandes paralympiennes en fauteuil roulant Tanni Grey-Thompson et Jade Jones. Tanni, avec son impressionnant palmarès de médailles et de records, est accompagnée de sa jeune protégée Jade, qui débute sa carrière en athlétisme.Avec les experts Phil Serrell et David Harper, la baronne du comté de Durham et Jade, de Middlesbrough, partiront à la recherche d'antiquités à vendre lors d'une vente aux enchères à Harrogate.Tanni tente également sa chance dans la fabrication traditionnelle du verre, tandis que Jade découvre l'histoire de l'homme qui fut un pionnier du design dans la région.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Hopper’s work is the most recognisable art in America – popular, praised, and mysterious. Countless painters, photographers, filmmakers and musicians have been influenced by his art – but who was he, and how did a struggling illustrator create such a bounty of notable work?This new film takes a deep look into Hopper’s art, his life, and his relationships. From his early career as an illustrator; his wife giving up her own promising art career to be his manager; his critical and commercial acclaim; and in his own words – this film explores the enigmatic personality behind the brush….

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Narrated by Gillian Anderson, this episode of Exhibition on Screen follows the footsteps of French artists such as Renoir and Monet, the American Impressionist movement forged its own path. Painted over a period of 40 years, these paintings reveal the United States both as a nation and as a creative breeding ground. The history of this movement is closely linked to the love of gardens and the desire to preserve nature in a country undergoing rapid urbanization. This enchanting journey through workshops, gardens and famous sites in the USA, UK and France is a feast for the eyes.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip - Season 1
programme.desc: Deux amies de la scène et de la télévision, Ruth Madoc et Su Pollard, connues pour leurs apparitions dans la sitcom Hi-De-Hi, partent à la chasse aux antiquités avec Phil Serrell et Raj Bisram. Partis de Monmouth, ville frontalière du Pays de Galles, ils se rendent à Congleton, dans le Cheshire, pour une vente aux enchères.Ruth découvre également l'incroyable infirmière du XIXe siècle - et ce n'est pas Florence Nightingale - tandis que Su visite l'ancienne ville romaine de Caerleon et trouve le temps d'affronter Phil dans un amphithéâtre.Et Su tente de résoudre un vieux mystère... Phil porte-t-il une perruque ?

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip - Season 1
programme.desc: Deux stars des années 70, le crooner cool Tony Christie et la royauté pop Jimmy Osmond, sont accompagnés des experts Catherine Southon et Margie Cooper. Partant de la ville de Loughborough, dans le Leicestershire, ils se dirigent vers une vente aux enchères à Stoke-on-Trent, dans le Staffordshire.Tony profite d'une visite à Coalbrookdale, le lieu où des techniques innovantes ont été développées, marquant le début de la révolution industrielle. De son côté, le passionné de voitures Jimmy s'offre un tour sur le circuit historique de Donington.La grande finale aux enchères comprend un moment de chant en groupe unique en son genre. Mais quel maestro musical remportera la victoire ?

programme.title: Museum stories
programme.desc: The city of Boulogne Billancourt experienced rapid development in the interwar period. Industrialists, filmmakers, architects, painters and sculptors test their creativity there. It is this impetus that the Museum of the 1930s would have liked to transcribe, created a collection of works of art from this period, first constituted by purchases in galleries, flea markets or auction houses, then mainly by donations. More than 1,500 sculptures, 800 paintings, 300 pieces of furniture… A heterogeneous whole, testimony of an era and a place in which the artistic excitement unfolds, and opens the way to a number of creative adventures of the 20th century.

programme.title: Travelers
programme.desc: Today, Travelers takes you to Warsaw, the capital of Poland, known for its varied architecture that reflects its long and eventful past. We'll start the tour in the Old Town Square to soak up the atmosphere, then head to the Zacheta Gallery, one of Poland's largest museums of contemporary and modern art. Warsaw and its history await you!

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.sub-title: Alley of Poplars by Sisley, Nice Museum of Fine Arts
programme.desc: Sisley was a British Impressionist painter, closely associated with Renoir and Monet. On 20 June 1978, at 8.30 pm, a truck was stolen. Inside were around ten masterpieces worth 1.5 billion francs. The transport company responsible for returning the works following a loan had made no security arrangements. On 21 September 1998, ‘The Avenue of Poplars’ was stolen once again. This time, it was the curator of the Musée des Beaux-Arts in Nice, Jean Fornéris, who staged his own abduction! Finally, on Sunday 5 August 2007, five masked and armed men held up staff at the Nice museum to steal four paintings, including the Sisley. It was not until 2008, with the help of the FBI – which was also searching for works stolen from the Boston Museum – that the thieves were arrested.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: Vandalised, stolen, cut into pieces, melted down and resold for a few thousand euros, even though they are worth millions: sculptures. On the night of 30–31 March 1999, whilst this park in the 6th arrondissement was closed to the public, individuals stole the sculpture of Picasso’s former muse and lover, Dora Maar: ‘Head of a Woman’, an 80-centimetre-tall bronze weighing 80 kilos. Two years later, in a town hall in the Paris suburbs, it stood proudly on the staircase: ‘Do you realise you’ve got a Picasso in your building?’ exclaimed an antique dealer who had come to visit the château. Indeed, the town hall had found a ‘large stone’ buried on a plot of land, had it cleaned, thought it was beautiful and displayed it in their château, unaware that it was a sculpture by Picasso….

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.sub-title: The Boy with a Soap Bubble, Rembrandt
programme.desc: On the evening of 13 July 1999, a day of celebrations in France, Rembrandt’s *The Boy with a Soap Bubble* disappeared from the Draguignan Municipal Museum. Patrick Vialaneix recounts how he fell in love with this painting at the age of 13. Thirteen years later, the painting continued to haunt him, and he decided to steal it so that he could always have it close to him and talk to it. He therefore hid in a cupboard in the museum, waiting for nightfall to make off with it. He turned himself in to the police in 2014.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: On the night of 17–18 October 1984, three criminals broke into the municipal museum in Semur-en-Auxois, which was not fitted with an alarm system. The joint investigation by the French and Japanese police revealed links between the Parisian underworld and the Japanese Yakuza mafia. Indeed, Shinchi Fujikuma, a Japanese gangster, had met two members of the Aubervilliers gang, Philippe-Emile Jamin and Youssef Khimoun, whilst serving time in a French prison. In 1987, the French managed to return from Japan with four of the five stolen paintings. The last one, *The Portrait of Mrs Baudot*, remained with its new owner, in accordance with the principle of ‘good faith’ guaranteed by Japanese law.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: La Dulwich Picture Gallery abrite une collection au destin incroyable ! En 1790, le roi de Pologne passa commande à deux marchands d’art installés à Londres. Ceux-ci achetèrent des peintures à travers l’Europe, qui restèrent en leur possession après l’effondrement de la Pologne. Ils léguèrent la collection au Dulwich College et, selon leur vœu, le premier musée d’art public anglais ouvrit ses portes en 1817. Découvrez ainsi des chefs d’œuvres de la main de Poussin, Rembrandt ou Murillo. Bonne visite !

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: Situé près de Compiègne, le château de Pierrefonds est un des plus puissants châteaux de Jean de Berry, démantelé et éventré sur ordre de Richelieu au XVIIe siècle, une des plus belles ruines médiévales, capable de suggérer tant de nostalgies romantiques au XIXe. Une ruine achetée par Napoléon III pour en faire restaurer une partie, et la transformer en demeure impériale...

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, nous vous parlerons de l’artiste Antoine Bourdelle. Fils de menuisier monté à la capitale, Antoine Bourdelle devient, au début du XXe siècle, le plus grand sculpteur officiel. Cet élève de Rodin a répondu à de nombreuses commandes en France et à l’étranger. Mais il a aussi conservé certaines de ses sculptures encore aujourd’hui présentes dans son atelier du quartier Montparnasse, un lieu magique, resté comme figé dans le passé.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip - Season 1
programme.sub-title: Tanni Grey Thompson and Jade Jones
programme.desc: Aujourd'hui, nous sommes dans le Nord-Est de l'Angleterre avec les grandes paralympiennes en fauteuil roulant Tanni Grey-Thompson et Jade Jones. Tanni, avec son impressionnant palmarès de médailles et de records, est accompagnée de sa jeune protégée Jade, qui débute sa carrière en athlétisme.Avec les experts Phil Serrell et David Harper, la baronne du comté de Durham et Jade, de Middlesbrough, partiront à la recherche d'antiquités à vendre lors d'une vente aux enchères à Harrogate.Tanni tente également sa chance dans la fabrication traditionnelle du verre, tandis que Jade découvre l'histoire de l'homme qui fut un pionnier du design dans la région.

programme.title: Photo Contest
programme.desc: In each episode of Photo Contest, two contestants compete on an imposed theme such as rock'n roll, Japan or architecture. They have one hour to take the best possible photographs before editing them for 30 minutes in a studio. The photographs they have selected are then presented to Agnès Grégoire, editor-in-chief of PHOTO magazine, who will have to choose the best photographer.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: In the Artist's workshop series, we offer you a privileged meeting with an artist, or the discovery of an artist or an important place for the history of art. Whether they are painters, visual artists, sculptors... These people all have the same passion for art and this show is an opportunity to enter their different universes, to discover what drives them, inspires them and maybe that will give rise to vocations.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a Netherland painter, Vincent van Gogh.You will discover his labour with Self-portrait, Memory of the garden at Etten, Van Gogh’s chair.

programme.title: An hour with
programme.desc: Take an hour break to discover the work of a Russian painter, Vassily Kandinsky. You will discover his labour with Old city n°2, Park of Saint-cloud, Rider (improvisation n°12).

programme.title: Video Art
programme.desc: Street art, performances, digital art... Because the new forms of Art and their invigorating character, even iconoclastic, have been able to attract a new public until now refractory to go inside the interior of our beautiful museums.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: Lucian Freud, l'un des peintres britanniques les plus célèbres de notre époque, est également l'un des rares artistes du XXe siècle à s'être représenté dans un autoportrait avec une telle constance. Ses autoportraits donnent un aperçu fascinant à la fois de sa personnalité et de son évolution en tant que peintre, depuis son premier portrait peint en 1939 jusqu'au dernier. Grâce à des entretiens fascinants avec d'anciens modèles, des amis et d'éminents experts, ce documentaire intensément captivant révèle l'œuvre d'un maître qui représente une étude captivante sur la dynamique du vieillissement et le processus d'autoreprésentation.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Réputé pour être le créateur de la peinture à l’huile, le peintre flamand Jan van Eyck (1390-1441) est un artiste majeur du 15ème siècle. Il est considéré comme étant le fondateur du portrait occidental qu’il a pratiqué très méticuleusement. Regardez de près la fameux « Portrait d’Arnolfini » exposé à la Galerie Nationale de Londres, le miroir circulaire au fond de la pièce montre le reflet de l’artiste. « La vierge du chancelier Rolin » exposé au Louvre, quant à elle montre une image dans laquelle trois arcs s’ouvrent sur un paysage fluvial.Bonne visite !

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Jean Auguste Dominique Ingres is best known as the painter of the odalisques. Obsessed with the ideal of beauty, he glorified the female form, with its porcelain whiteness and its curves… Ingres struck a path between Classicism and the influence of the Orient. You will see the famous women bathers in “The Turkish Bath” and also some of his historic paintings such as “Oedipus and the Sphinx” and, of course, his portraits, with the famous “Monsieur Bertin”. Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Sketchbook
programme.desc: Raphael Federici (street artist), Marine Goodmorning (illustrator), Luca Fiore (cartoonist) and Harry Boudchicha (drawing teacher) reveal their best drawing techniques. Each episode focuses on a specific subject:movement, oil painting, shadows, hair... For the first 10 minutes, each artist gives a theoretical lesson illustrated by sketches. Then they each start working on their creation. Finally, they end with a debrief, comparingand explaining their techniques.

programme.title: Little Sketches
programme.desc: In 64 fun episodes, Gia-Haï Phan teaches you all the sketching techniques you need.

programme.title: Architectures
programme.desc: A tall tower in the heart of Copenhagen, the RADISSON SAS ROYAL HOTEL is both a grand modern hotel and an airline terminal, marking Denmark's entry into post-war modernity. It was a major work of the 1950s, under the banner of functionalism, simplicity and elegance. This total work of art, where everything from the ashtray to the volume of the building was conceived and designed by the same man, Arne Jacobsen, the great Scandinavian architect and designer.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Léonard à la National Gallery de Londres
programme.desc: Un événement remarquable s'est produit à la National Gallery de Londres lorsque la plus grande collection jamais constituée de peintures de Léonard de Vinci a été réunie dans une exposition unique : Léonard de Vinci : peintre à la cour de Milan. Léonard est reconnu comme étant peut-être le plus grand peintre et sculpteur de tous les temps, mais ses talents ne s'arrêtaient pas là. Ce film raconte sa vie et s'étend sur Léonard le visionnaire, Léonard l'inventeur. Depuis l'endroit où il a vécu ses dernières années au Château du Clos Lucé en France, nous verrons que Léonard de Vinci était peut-être l'incarnation même de l'esprit de la Renaissance.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Les impressionnistes - et l'homme qui les a créés
programme.desc: Ce sont les artistes les plus populaires du monde. Les œuvres de Cézanne, Monet, Degas et leurs compatriotes représentent des richesses inestimables. Mais qui étaient-ils vraiment ? Comment et pourquoi ont-ils révolutionné l’histoire de l’art ? Qu’est-ce qui se cache derrière leur succès intemporel ? Pour répondre à ces questions, le documentaire a obtenu un accès unique à une grande exposition mettant l’accent sur le collectionneur d’art parisien du 19ème siècle, Paul Durand-Ruel, l’expert des Impressionnistes qui prit la décision courageuse d’exposer les Impressionnistes à New York en 1886 et ainsi introduire la société américaine à la peinture française moderne.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.sub-title: Degas : une passion de la perfection
programme.desc: Exhibition on screen nous emmène à travers les rues de Paris puis au cœur d’une superbe exposition au Fitzwilliam Museum de Cambridge, dont l’impressionnante collection d’œuvres de Degas est la plus représentative de Grande-Bretagne. Ayant bénéficié d’un accès exclusif à une grande variété d’œuvres rares, le film raconte l’histoire fascinante de la quête de perfection de Degas à travers l’expérimentation de nouvelles techniques et les leçons apprises en étudiant les grands maîtres.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Tiziano Vecellio dit Le Titien est un maître incontesté de la peinture du 16ème siècle ! Sa renommée dépassa rapidement sa ville natale, Venise, pour s’étendre à toute l’Italie et à l’Europe. Papes, rois et empereurs lui commandèrent des portraits. Innovations techniques, reconnaissance sociale et peintures célébrissimes, à l’image du Concert champêtre ou de la Vénus d’Urbin, jalonnent la vie du Titien. Une vie qui impressionne tout autant par sa richesse que sa longueur. Bonne visite !

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: A key artist of the Italian Renaissance, Raffaello Santi (1483-1520) developed a classical art form, based on drawing, which made him the model for many painters in the following centuries. His favourite theme was the Madonna: you can admire, for example, “The Sistine Madonna” in Dresden and the “The Virgin and Child with St John the Baptist” in the Louvre. Notice the gentle harmony and the delicate sensuality in “The Three Graces” or the powerful human presence in “The Portrait of Baldassare Castiglione”.Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip - Season 1
programme.desc: Les légendes de la scène et de l'écran, Charles Dance et Geraldine James, rejoignent les experts en antiquités Natasha Raskin et Will Axon pour cette excursion dans le Wiltshire.Charles trouve une paire de vases en argent de l'époque édouardienne qu'il espère rentabiliser lors d'une vente aux enchères dans l'Essex. Geraldine, elle, tombe sur un homme dans la rue avec un secrétaire Empire français du XIXe siècle. Il lui en coûte une petite fortune - le pari sera-t-il gagnant ?Charles se retrouve dans le cockpit d'un très vieil hélicoptère tandis que Geraldine apprend comment un petit quartier de Swindon datant de 170 ans a influencé la création du NHS moderne.

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: Painted by the Van Eyck brothers, ‘The Adoration of the Mystical Lamb’ or ‘The Ghent Altarpiece’ is regarded as one of the greatest masterpieces of the Flemish Primitives. Installed in St Bavon’s Cathedral in Ghent as early as 1432, it escaped theft and looting on several occasions, However, on the night of 10–11 April 1934, two panels were stolen, one of which – ‘The Just Judges’ – has never been recovered to this day, because the bishop refused to pay the ransom demanded….

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.desc: Vandalised, stolen, cut into pieces, melted down and resold for a few thousand euros, even though they are worth millions: sculptures. On the night of 30–31 March 1999, whilst this park in the 6th arrondissement was closed to the public, individuals stole the sculpture of Picasso’s former muse and lover, Dora Maar: ‘Head of a Woman’, an 80-centimetre-tall bronze weighing 80 kilos. Two years later, in a town hall in the Paris suburbs, it stood proudly on the staircase: ‘Do you realise you’ve got a Picasso in your building?’ exclaimed an antique dealer who had come to visit the château. Indeed, the town hall had found a ‘large stone’ buried on a plot of land, had it cleaned, thought it was beautiful and displayed it in their château, unaware that it was a sculpture by Picasso….

programme.title: Stolen Treasures
programme.sub-title: Alley of Poplars by Sisley, Nice Museum of Fine Arts
programme.desc: Sisley was a British Impressionist painter, closely associated with Renoir and Monet. On 20 June 1978, at 8.30 pm, a truck was stolen. Inside were around ten masterpieces worth 1.5 billion francs. The transport company responsible for returning the works following a loan had made no security arrangements. On 21 September 1998, ‘The Avenue of Poplars’ was stolen once again. This time, it was the curator of the Musée des Beaux-Arts in Nice, Jean Fornéris, who staged his own abduction! Finally, on Sunday 5 August 2007, five masked and armed men held up staff at the Nice museum to steal four paintings, including the Sisley. It was not until 2008, with the help of the FBI – which was also searching for works stolen from the Boston Museum – that the thieves were arrested.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: With loans from across the world, this major retrospective brings together Vermeer’s most famous masterpieces including Girl with a Pearl Earring, The Geographer, The Milkmaid, The Little Street, Lady Writing a Letter with her Maid, and Woman Holding a Balance. In all, 28 of his surviving 37 works. This film invites audiences to a privileged view of the exhibition, accompanied by the director of the Rijksmuseum and the curators of the show. A truly once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to discover the genius of Vermeer and his fascinating and mysterious life.

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: The spectacular sculptures and paintings of Michelangelo seem so familiar to us, but what do we really know about this renaissance genius? Who was this ambitious and passionate man? A virtuoso craftsman, Michelangelo’s artistry is evident in everything he touched. Beautiful and diverse works such as the towering statue of David, the deeply moving Pietà in the Papal Basilica of St. Peter and his tour-de-force, the Sistine Chapel ceiling still leave us breathless today.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip - Season 1
programme.desc: Top Italian cooks Antonio Carluccio and Gennaro Contraldo are on a Road Trip around East Anglia. Restaurateurs, writers and old friends the ‘greedy Italians’ will be foraging for antiques in the company of experts David Harper and James Braxton. Watch out for some ‘explosive’ bargaining and an extremely tasty risotto! When he’s not shopping Antonio learns about the brave fisherman of Suffolk who saved mariners’ lives while risking their own. And, Gennaro has a trip to take a peek at a very special bird.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip - Season 1
programme.desc: Les coachs vocaux et couple marié David et Carrie Grant échangent l'harmonie vocale contre une compétition acharnée d'antiquités. Avec l'aide des experts Will Axon et Mark Stacey, le couple découvre des objets inattendus à vendre lors d’une vente aux enchères dans la campagne du Norfolk.David fait une halte sur un terrain d'herbe en plein cœur de Cambridge, où aujourd'hui les enfants jouent et les chiens se promènent, mais qui était en réalité le berceau du football. Pendant ce temps, Carrie découvre comment Letchworth Garden City a déclenché une révolution dans la conception des villes.

programme.title: Museum stories
programme.desc: In the heart of the Montparnasse district, the Bourdelle Museum remains one of the last testimonies of these groups of artists which flourished in Paris at the threshold of the 20th century. The Antoine Bourdelle Museum offers an opportunity to see the work being created it, as close as possible to the material, in the museum's workshop spirit. Plaster, earth, sandstone and bronzes, but also sketches, variations and variations, reveal the process of development and the working method of an artist as fertile as inventive.

programme.title: Travelers
programme.desc: Today, Travelers takes you to Lodz in Poland, a city with a lot of artistic potential. We'll start our tour on Piotr Cozca Avenue, which stretches for 4.2 kilometers. We will then go to the city's history museum, and to the Manufaktura, a former factory turned shopping center. We will also talk about cinema by visiting a school that has trained some of the greatest directors.

programme.title: Firemen of Paris: saving Notre-Dame!
programme.desc: The fire at Notre-Dame de Paris on April 15, 2019, shocked the world. The flames ravaged the cathedral's roof and threatened to destroy its historic heritage, including its precious stained-glass windows and millennia-old sculptures.The firefighters worked tirelessly to bring the blaze under control, managing to save the main structure and some of the most precious relics.The incident sparked a massive wave of international solidarity, with pledges of funding for the reconstruction of this iconic building, which is a symbol of French culture and history.

programme.title: A night in Orsay with Charles Berling
programme.desc: The Musée d’Orsay not only houses the largest collection of impressionist and post-impressionist masterpieces in the world, but the building itself is impressive. What about visiting it alone at night with a theatrical guide?

programme.title: Exhibition on Screen
programme.desc: « Les Tournesols » sont parmi les tableaux de Van Gogh les plus célèbres. Le musée Van Gogh à Amsterdam a consacré une exposition à ces œuvres et « Exhibition on screen », qui a eu un accès exclusif à l’événement, nous guide à travers l’exposition pour enquêter sur les mystères qui entourent ces tableaux. Le film nous amènera également à Tokyo, Philadelphie, Londres et Munich pour suivre les 5 principales œuvres de l’exposition.

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: With his considerable production of more than 6,000 works, Auguste Renoir took part in the emergence of the impressionist movement even if he were to distance himself from it later to assert a more personal style. This visit begins with his most famous masterpiece, the “Ball at the Moulin de la Galette”. You will also rediscover the “Dance in the City” and the “Piano Lesson” exposed at the Joslyn art museum as well as “Claude Renoir in Clown Costume”, a portrait of his son who was later to become one of France’s greatest film directors exposed at the Orangerie Museum in France Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Within the frame
programme.desc: Of Spanish origin, Francis Picabia was an active member of the Dada group. However, being both provocative and iconoclastic, he soon began to scorn the serious nature of the avant-garde movements. His painting was at times realistic, at times abstract, and he sought above all to explore potential in art. This collection opens the doors of the Centre Pompidou (Paris) which presents some of Picabia’s major works, such as his famous “Cacodylic Eye” and “Adoration of the Calf”, recently acquired by the museum. Enjoy your visit!

programme.title: Architectures
programme.sub-title: L'irrésistible construction du Musée de Picardie
programme.desc: Le Musée de Picardie à Amiens est un prototype. C’est le premier Musée construit en tant que tel en France. Mais sa construction n’a pas été chose facile. Le Musée s’est d’abord voulu un «Petit Louvre», un palais. Ce n’est que petit à petit, au gré d’un chantier qui a duré 40 ans - un record ! - et à travers des remises en cause spectaculaires, que le Musée a triomphé du Monument, que l’objet d’architecture s’est adapté à sa véritable fonction. Sept architectes se sont succédés pour mener le projet à son terme : un chef d’oeuvre anonyme.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, nous rencontrerons l’artiste Ben. Actif sur la scène de la création contemporaine depuis plus de 50 ans, il est un personnage autodidacte aux multiples facettes. Son succès est indéniable. Si son statut d’artiste s’affirme à travers ses célèbres écritures peintes en lettres cursives blanches sur fond noir, son tempérament de « touche à tout » a fait de lui l’une des personnalités artistiques les plus avant-garde du monde de l’art depuis les années 1960. Attaché plus que tout à sa région, l’artiste travaille et vit depuis plus de 40 ans sur les hauteurs de Nice à Saint-Pancrace, dans une maison où chaque pièce peut devenir atelier, et où le manque progressif de place, l’a amené à créer une extension dont il nous ouvre aujourd’hui les portes.

programme.title: Artist's Workshop
programme.desc: Joaquin Boz habite et travaille à Buenos Aires. C’est ici, dans la capitale de l’Argentine, qu’il pratique son art à mi-chemin entre abstraction et performance corporelle. Sa peinture est recouverte de couches toujours plus nombreuses. Ces tâches, ces mouvements, ces traits et ces raclures, sont le fruit de la transmission des formes et des couleurs depuis son corps vers la toile dans une performance physique de l’artiste qui puise son inspiration dans le courant expressionniste.

programme.title: Celebrity Antiques Road Trip - Season 1
programme.desc: Comedy legend Jennifer Saunders and best pal, top actress Patricia Potter take to the road on a humdinger of a trip. Joined by veteran antiquers Phillip Serrell and Mark Stacey they shop in Berkshire, Hampshire and Oxfordshire before heading for an auction in Greenwich, London. Jennifer and Phil detour to hear about Fred Karno, the man credited with inventing slapstick comedy. While Patricia and Mark learn how a surgeon from Reading used his incredible sense of smell to successfully treat soldiers injured in World War One.And, Phil gets custard pied – what’s not to love?

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Aujourd’hui, les plus gourmands ne devraient pas être déçus puisque c’est le chocolat qui est mis à l’honneur. Découvert par les mayas il y 2500 ans et plus largement ensuite par les Aztèques, le chocolat fait partie aujourd’hui des produits préférés des français. Et qu’on ne s’y trompe pas : au même titre que la cuisine a ses grands chef, le chocolat a aussi ses grands chocolatiers. Coté recettes, Julie fera découvrir un gâteau qu’on ne fait qu’à Saint Émilien et qui associe le chocolat au macaron, avant de rejoindre le Pays Basque pour un dessert qui ne manque pas de piment. Nous grimperons ensuite en montagne à la rencontre d’une cuisinière d’origine suisse qui fait des pains au chocolat à sa façon. Enfin, vous verrez que le chocolat nous réserve de nombreuses surprises : il possède de nombreuses vertus et s’utilise aussi pour le bien être.

programme.title: Health Investigation
programme.sub-title: Dietary Supplements: Healthy Dose of Misinformation?
programme.desc: Dietary Supplements: Helpful or Dangerous?They’re flooding the shelves of pharmacies, supermarkets, and health food stores. Brewer’s yeast, vitamins, passionflower, spirulina… More than one in two French people have already taken dietary supplements to get back in shape or stay healthy.A capsule for memory, a tablet for stress, a herbal detox programme… The promises made by dietary supplements are tempting. These products are guaranteed to be 100 per cent natural, which stands in stark contrast to the chemical image associated with medicines. But are they really effective and safe?The range of dietary supplements on offer is vast, with over 150 million packs sold in France every year. As summer approaches, many female consumers turn to slimming products. A flat tummy, slimmer legs… Their promises sound too good to be true, but are they actually effective for weight loss?Drug interactions, serious side effects… Dietary supplements can sometimes be dangerous, particularly as their qu.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Honey was the first sweet condiment in history! It has also been known and consumed as a remedy since Antiquity. In France, we find an infinite variety of honey: acacia, chestnut, fir, rosemary, orange, spruce, oak, linden or lavender... We'll cross forests, fields and even towns, as bees also forage in urbanized areas. We'll then cook up emblematic recipes like Vercel gingerbread. Finally, we'll discover the European dark bee. Protecting this 80-million-year-old bee has become the spearhead of some passionate beekeepers.

programme.title: Health Investigation
programme.sub-title: Bipolar Disorder: From One Extreme to the Other
programme.desc: Are We All Bipolar?We all experience mood swings in life. But when emotions become too intense, leading to uncontrollable reactions and all kinds of extreme behavior, we’re talking about bipolar disorder—a condition that affects more than one million people in France.In recent years, this disorder has regularly been in the media spotlight. Benoît Poelvoorde, Catherine Zeta-Jones, Jim Carrey… Many are said to suffer from bipolar disorder and have spoken openly about it. Yet, far from being a passing fad, it is a serious and highly debilitating mental illness.Switching from euphoria to depression in a matter of days is what characterizes this disorder, formerly known as manic-depressive psychosis. Excitement, grandiose plans, sadness, and an inability to experience pleasure are the lot of patients who must learn to manage these erratic moods.Despite these signs, it takes more than 10 years on average for a diagnosis to be made. This medical delay can have dramatic consequences. One.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Today, we're off to discover summer fruits, which are harvested from June to August: peaches, melons, strawberries, raspberries... We'll then head to the cherry capital, Céret, and cook blueberries, strawberries and an apricot charlotte.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Let's hit the roads of France to discover shellfish. We'll visit Brittany, then the Normandy coast where fishing is the regional sport, and Corsica, where the far northeast of the island lives to the rhythm of lobster. Julie takes us to cook lobster, crab with a very special recipe, and langoustines.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie nous emmène en Bretagne sud et plus précisément dans le quartier maritime du Guilvinec pour faire avec vous la route du poisson depuis les filets jusqu’à vos assiettes. Le Guilvinec a beau être le premier port de pêche artisanale français, tous les bords de mers de l’hexagone réservent de bons produits de saison. Julie remonte donc en voiture pour découvrir dans le sud un certain nombre de poissons d’élevage dans une ferme aquacole en Méditerranée, tout en cuisinant le bar à Noirmoutier, la lotte dans le Nord et même le cabillaud dans l’immense marché de Rungis. Julie a challengé le Chef Olivier Bellin installé à Plomodiern dans le Finistère, pour qu’il cuisine un poisson méconnu : la vieille.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Aujourd'hui c'est sur la route des champignons que Julie nous embarque. Rien de mieux pour occuper ses week-ends qu’une balade en forêt à la recherche de champignons comestibles. Certaines espèces, comme le cèpe ou la girolle, se conservent très bien au congélateur ou, pour les plus patients, en bocaux. Nous aurons également l'occasion de rencontrer deux Chefs passionnés par les champignons, devenus des spécialistes du sujet : Franck Quinton et Régis Marcon. Mais pour l’instant on prend la route, à la découverte de plats typiquement français avec d’étonnants champignons de Paris en Touraine, des morilles dans le Jura, des cèpes en Gironde, des russules charbonnières en Normandie et des coulemelles en Auvergne !

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Pour les paresseux et tous ceux qui n’ont pas le temps, Luana Belmondo propose deux petites recettes simples et efficaces. Découvrez son pain à l'ail et au fromage, et ses spaghettis à l'ail.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: Canada is the second largest country in the world by land mass and contains amazing natural resources: 7% of the Earth’s drinking water is spread over the country’s thousands of lakes. Forests cover 45% of the territory. Yann Arthus-Bertrand goes off to discover these resources with those whose job it is to protect them. He takes a look at the ecological balance sheet of the world’s eighth-largest economic power.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie prend la direction de la Bourgogne pour découvrir des races anciennes de volaille réintroduites en France grâce au travail de l’éleveur Fred Ménager. Nous nous rapprocherons ensuite de l’Auvergne pour découvrir comment est attribué le fameux Label Rouge et le rôle des organismes certificateurs … car il est important de savoir ce qui atterri dans nos assiettes. Julie se rendra aussi dans la Drôme pour cuisiner de la pintade avant de se diriger vers le Périgord pour préparer un civet de dindon. Installée dans sa petite Micheline, Julie remontera ensuite vers le centre pour découvrir un étonnant fabricant de mouche qui utilise des plumes de coqs !

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: Défendre l’eau c’est défendre la vie - Partie 1
programme.desc: The oceans cover more than 70% of the Earth's surface. The sea is the largest natural environment on our planet and remains virtually unexploited. In Brittany, in the Seven Islands. Then in the Bay of Saint-Brieuc, in the middle of a sea of green algae. In Brittany, intensive agriculture has developed over the last thirty years. In New Caledonia, the coral reef is the second largest in the world and could be threatened by the construction of a nickel mine. In Normandy, in the Botanical Garden of Vauville, an extraordinary garden has plants from all over the world. Also in the Archipelago of Chausey in Normandy with the highest tides in Europe. Or the Mont Saint Michel. As a result of silting up and man-made works, the Mont was no longer an island. In Italy, in Venice, on the verge of drowning, major development work, industrialisation and tourism have upset the environment. In New Caledonia, flying over the heart of Voh is surrounded by the largest lagoon in the world. 24,000 km2 prot.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Si l’été est la saison où les légumes abondent au potager, il serait dommage de ne pas savourer ceux que les saisons plus fraîches nous offrent : potages, tourtes, potées ou gratins mettent à l’honneur des légumes de saisons, idéals pour se réchauffer. Pour débuter ce nouveau voyage, un légume qui trônait déjà sur les tables de la Grèce Antique : le salsifis que Julie cuisinera avec une drôle de tourtière…L’hiver c’est aussi la saison du chou alors direction la Champagne pour y apprendre la recette de la potée locale qui devrait remplir le ventre d’un grand nombre de convives.Ce petit tour de France nous emmènera aussi à la découverte d’orfèvres du maraîchage qui sculptent légumes et fruits d’hiver, et vous présentera différentes techniques et méthodes pour sublimer vos potagers.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: The call of the Forest is about discovering places but above all it is about meeting those who protect this priceless heritage. Forests are essential to mankind. They capture CO2, promote the formation of clouds and therefore rain, protect the soil from erosion and provide a habitat for wildlife. From Madagascar, to France, to Cameroon, or even Eritrea, Yann Arthus-Bertrand sets out to discover the most beautiful forests, those who live in them, those who protect them and those who live off them.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie takes us on a journey of spices and aromatic plants. Spices are a call to travel, to faraway lands and to the unknown. On her journey, Julie will introduce us to the famous black pepper.

programme.title: My Zen Nutrition
programme.desc: Enjoy delicious and yummy recipes, easy, healthy and fast to prepare with our My Zen Nutrition tutorials!

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Cap au Nord pour découvrir une ville française absolument incontournable : Lille. Cette ville possède un patrimoine architectural exceptionnel, marchande dès le Moyen Age, citadelle sous Louis XIV, industrielle au XIXe...elle s'agrandit au cours des siècles. Julie ira à la rencontre de ceux qui participent à la renommée de la ville et de la région, et à travers son patrimoine culinaire avec au menu de ce voyage : la recette du coq à la bière, celle du hochepot, et sur une note sucrée, une crème brûlée à la chicorée. .

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: It is in the heart of the Sarthe that Julie begins her new tour. Located in the Pays de la Loire region, the Sarthe department is the gateway to the French Grand Ouest. In the Haut Maine region, Le Mans is a city of art as well as a historic city, which played a decisive role in the development of the automobile. The country of Le Mans is distinguished by the diversity of its heritage, having kept in its stones the imprints of all eras. This region is notably renowned for its poulet de Loué, its capon and many other regional specialities. Let's go for a real Sarthe gourmet journey, with veal rouelles à la mancelle, roast poularde and seasonal fruit tart.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Dans cet épisode, nous allons voyager au Mexique avec les fajitas ! Un plat typique de la cuisine tex-mex. On va préparer ensemble des tortillas (galettes de maïs). Et pour la suite, des fajitas avec du poulet, des poivrons et des épices.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Luana cooks with the interpreter of the flagship title of Frozen: Anaïs Delva. Together, they will prepare two 100% vegetarian recipes, a philosophy adopted by the singer. On the menu: grilled zucchini fettucini, white beans with pesto and a vegetarian burger. Proof that it's possible to enjoy vegetarian dishes without going hungry!

programme.title: Ways to School
programme.desc: Yu Qiang is 12 years old. He belongs to the Lisu tribe and lives with his family in the village of Qia Ma Ga in the Nu Jiang prefecture of Yunnan province. To get to school, the children must first learn to use the zip line, their only means of reaching the other bank of the Nu Jiang river, where their school is located. A single mistake could have fatal consequences. The children must undertake this adventure every ten days. It's a dangerous journey, but one with its moments of joy.

programme.title: Ways to School
programme.desc: Abduwale, 9, lives with his family in the far west of China. His parents are Kyrgyz shepherds, so for six months of the year they set up their yurt in Xinjiang province when the snow gives way to green pastures. Every morning, Abduwale rides his donkey to school with his big sister Fatima and best friend Subinur. The three children stick together through thick and thin, enabling them to face the dangers of the road, especially during the snowmelt. For Abduwale, Fatima and Subinur, the road to school is an adventure that leads them to their real challenge: education.

programme.title: Ways to School
programme.desc: Lu Tiansen is 13 years old and lives with his family on the island of Chang Yao in China. Every Monday, Tiansen and his friends make the two-hour journey to their school, located on the mainland opposite the island. To get there on time, after their boat crossing, they take shortcuts through the rice fields to a dark tunnel. But thanks to their good humor, they always overcome their obstacles.

programme.title: 100 Places to See
programme.desc: The Pays d'Auge is the beating heart of Normandy. Honfleur with its picturesque port, the Basilica of Lisieux, a major pilgrimage site, and the Haras du Pin, the cradle of horse breeding, illustrate the diversity of this land of traditions, where craftsmanship and gastronomy reign supreme.

programme.title: Ways to School
programme.desc: Yang Jiao Jiao is 11 years old and lives with her family in a village in the mountains of the Qinghai Tibetan highlands. Yang Jiao Jiao's home is 3,000 meters above sea level, while her school is in the valley. In these hostile, high-altitude regions, the journey to school is difficult. Every Monday, the children have to cross gullies, screes, rivers and steep paths, but they never give up and help each other. Along the way, they always find a way to have fun: they sing to the sun to get through the rain, they stop to pray at a temple and look after a bird.

programme.title: Ways to School
programme.desc: Mabally, 13, is a Bagyeli Pygmy. The equatorial forest where he lives with his family is the only world he knows. Every term, he has to cross the jungle to reach his class. It's a three-hour walk through the slippery clay hills of southern Cameroon.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Tendre et savoureux, l’agneau tient une place prépondérante dans la cuisine festive mais aussi dans celle de tous les jours. Du Pays Basque au Cotentin en passant par Paris, Julie part donc sur les routes de France à la découverte des différentes races et types d'élevage existant à travers le pays. Il faut dire que la France a l'une des productions les plus variées au monde. Il existe plus d'une quarantaine de races répertoriées en 5 catégories : précoces, d’herbage, rustiques, mérinos et laitières. Mais plus qu’à la race, c’est à la façon dont ils sont alimentés qui intéresse les fins connaisseurs. Julie nous fait découvrir ses producteurs et cuisiniers de ce met raffiné !

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: C’est à nouveau sur les routes de France que l’on retrouve aujourd’hui Julie pour parler d’un produit incontournable des tables françaises : le fromage. Plus qu’un engouement gourmand, plus qu’une friandise de fins de repas, le fromage est associé à l’image de la gastronomie française, et d’ailleurs reconnu patrimoine immatériel par l’UNESCO. Les français ne s’y sont pas trompés : avec près de 1 000 variétés - des pâtes molles, aux pâtes cuites, persillées, ou encore pressées, et avec 45 Appellations, nous sommes les plus gros consommateurs de fromage au monde !

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Auxerre is cut by valleys whose best exposed slopes are home to vineyards. The meandering course of the Yonne runs vertically through this region. To the east of Auxerre, the Chablis region is rounded with hills. The vineyard, extending on both sides of the valley of the Serein. To the south, lined by the Nivernais canal, the upper Yonne valley attracts climbing enthusiasts and boaters, before being swollen by the waters of the Cure. The region is renowned throughout the world for the quality of its wines, particularly those of Chablis. Julie begins her journey in Auxerre and then proposes typical recipes from the area: croquignoles and cherry clafoutis.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: This week, it is 80 kms from the capital, in Fontainebleau, that Julie is putting down her bags. Fontainebleau, a name famous throughout the world, a magical name which evokes for some a forest, for others a castle, a name which still shines with its royal history. The forest of Fontainebleau has inspired the art world since the beginning of the 19th century. Landscape painters such as Corot and Millet drew inspiration for their works there. But Fontainebleau has many other treasures in its bag, and gastronomy is part of its heritage. This is what Julie will discover through three recipes: Quail with grapes, raspberry and poppy pie and crayfish grave.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Julie is offering you a trip to the south of France. Between the Rhone Valley and the Mediterranean, let's discover a fruit that is harvested in November: the olive.

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Les apéros improvisés, ce n’est pas toujours facile. Quand les amis débarquent sans prévenir, le stress peut vite monter. Pas de panique, Luana Belmondo et Thomas Clouet, grand spécialiste en la matière, improvisent un apéro au pied levé avec trois fois rien. Des macarons de champignons, un mini tartare de bœuf, et le tour est joué !

programme.title: Luana's Kitchen
programme.desc: Wellness cuisine is not synonymous with sadness and insipidity. It can be extremely gourmet, for a balanced way to indulge yourself. On this theme, Luana welcomes young wellness pastry chef Johanna Le Pape. Together, they will prepare recipes that are both tasty and perfectly balanced: corn pizza with vegetables and peach-cassis and verbena puffs...

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: Canada is the second largest country in the world by land mass and contains amazing natural resources: 7% of the Earth’s drinking water is spread over the country’s thousands of lakes. Forests cover 45% of the territory. Yann Arthus-Bertrand goes off to discover these resources with those whose job it is to protect them. He takes a look at the ecological balance sheet of the world’s eighth-largest economic power.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.sub-title: Défendre l’eau c’est défendre la vie - Partie 1
programme.desc: The oceans cover more than 70% of the Earth's surface. The sea is the largest natural environment on our planet and remains virtually unexploited. In Brittany, in the Seven Islands. Then in the Bay of Saint-Brieuc, in the middle of a sea of green algae. In Brittany, intensive agriculture has developed over the last thirty years. In New Caledonia, the coral reef is the second largest in the world and could be threatened by the construction of a nickel mine. In Normandy, in the Botanical Garden of Vauville, an extraordinary garden has plants from all over the world. Also in the Archipelago of Chausey in Normandy with the highest tides in Europe. Or the Mont Saint Michel. As a result of silting up and man-made works, the Mont was no longer an island. In Italy, in Venice, on the verge of drowning, major development work, industrialisation and tourism have upset the environment. In New Caledonia, flying over the heart of Voh is surrounded by the largest lagoon in the world. 24,000 km2 prot.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: We end up at Yellowstone National Park in the United States, it is located in the first natural park created in the world. In Peru, the Amazon rainforest is suffering from massive deforestation. The desert on Beijing's doorstep is regularly hit by sandstorms. Some experts predict that the Chinese capital could be threatened by deserts within a hundred years. In Montana, American agricultural productivity has an ecological and human cost. Engineer Marc Dufumier explains how mechanisation is undermining the natural balance. In Brazil, agrofuels have made it possible to reduce dependence on oil, cut urban air pollution and even limit greenhouse gas emissions. In Los Angeles, human activities have disrupted the greenhouse effect and exacerbated it. Today, the Earth is heating up.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: The call of the Forest is about discovering places but above all it is about meeting those who protect this priceless heritage. Forests are essential to mankind. They capture CO2, promote the formation of clouds and therefore rain, protect the soil from erosion and provide a habitat for wildlife. From Madagascar, to France, to Cameroon, or even Eritrea, Yann Arthus-Bertrand sets out to discover the most beautiful forests, those who live in them, those who protect them and those who live off them.

programme.title: Earth from Above
programme.desc: How can we reconcile the development needed to sustain the lives of nearly seven billion people with the protection of the Earth's natural resources? Yann Arthus-Bertrand and his team have chosen Gabon to continue their survey of the planet. We'll be discovering the Kongou Falls, the Langoué clearing with their elephant in Gabon. Then in Colombia, we will go on the island of Malpelo with their shark. Back to Gabon we will discover the Minkébé National Park and the bats in Franceville. We will also go to India in Hyderabad, which has convinced farmers to use no pesticides and no GMOs in their cultivation.

programme.desc: Julie nous donne rendez-vous à Bordeaux après avoir arpenté le pays de Blaye, visité deux fois le bassin et parcouru les terres du Libournais à deux reprises, il fallait bien s’arrêter un jour dans la capitale du Bordelais ! N’y-a-t-il pas meilleure saison que le mois de septembre pour découvrir la perle d’Aquitaine, plus souvent appelée « Cité du vin » ? Julie donne rendez-vous à ces habitants pour découvrir les traditions mais aussi les projets plus récents de cette ville chargée d’Histoire et de gastronomie.

programme.title: Ways to School
programme.desc: Abduwale, 9, lives with his family in the far west of China. His parents are Kyrgyz shepherds, so for six months of the year they set up their yurt in Xinjiang province when the snow gives way to green pastures. Every morning, Abduwale rides his donkey to school with his big sister Fatima and best friend Subinur. The three children stick together through thick and thin, enabling them to face the dangers of the road, especially during the snowmelt. For Abduwale, Fatima and Subinur, the road to school is an adventure that leads them to their real challenge: education.

programme.title: Ways to School
programme.desc: Lu Tiansen is 13 years old and lives with his family on the island of Chang Yao in China. Every Monday, Tiansen and his friends make the two-hour journey to their school, located on the mainland opposite the island. To get there on time, after their boat crossing, they take shortcuts through the rice fields to a dark tunnel. But thanks to their good humor, they always overcome their obstacles.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: C'est à Giverny que démarre le voyage de Julie, celui dont le nom résonne immédiatement comme le berceau de l’Impressionnisme a gardé une authenticité émouvante, Giverny impose son style, murmure son histoire. Sa notoriété est fortement liée à la présence historique de Claude Monet et à tous les fabuleux témoins laissés par ce dernier. Claude Monet a aussi laissé son empreinte dans la cuisine à Giverny. Ses carnets de recettes sont là pour en témoigner. C’est dans ces carnets que Julie va s’inspirer pour remplir le sien, au menu : Lapin en compote, feuilleté d’andouilles au camembert, et charlottes aux abricots.

programme.title: Ways to School
programme.desc: Yang Jiao Jiao is 11 years old and lives with her family in a village in the mountains of the Qinghai Tibetan highlands. Yang Jiao Jiao's home is 3,000 meters above sea level, while her school is in the valley. In these hostile, high-altitude regions, the journey to school is difficult. Every Monday, the children have to cross gullies, screes, rivers and steep paths, but they never give up and help each other. Along the way, they always find a way to have fun: they sing to the sun to get through the rain, they stop to pray at a temple and look after a bird.

programme.title: Ways to School
programme.desc: Mabally, 13, is a Bagyeli Pygmy. The equatorial forest where he lives with his family is the only world he knows. Every term, he has to cross the jungle to reach his class. It's a three-hour walk through the slippery clay hills of southern Cameroon.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook
programme.desc: Cap au Nord pour découvrir une ville française absolument incontournable : Lille. Cette ville possède un patrimoine architectural exceptionnel, marchande dès le Moyen Age, citadelle sous Louis XIV, industrielle au XIXe...elle s'agrandit au cours des siècles. Julie ira à la rencontre de ceux qui participent à la renommée de la ville et de la région, et à travers son patrimoine culinaire avec au menu de ce voyage : la recette du coq à la bière, celle du hochepot, et sur une note sucrée, une crème brûlée à la chicorée. .

programme.title: Ways to School
programme.desc: Nasta arrived in Mayotte one night in her mother's arms on a clandestine boat, when she was 4 months old. A little girl rescued from the waters, she crosses her shanty town four times a day to go to school. At the age of 9, Nasta walks alone through this maze of corrugated iron sheets. An hour and a half spent in the dust of a dirt track.

programme.title: Afrikas elvegiganter
programme.desc: Afrikas kraftfulle elver huser et variert utvalg av beboere slik som elefanter og flodhester som spiser og drikker der krokodillene jakter og formerer seg. Vi avslører hvordan disse gigantiske dyrene ufrivillig deler vannet med andre, mindre skapninger slik som pinnsvin, kampørner og leoparder.

programme.title: Africa's Ghost River
programme.desc: Hvert år renner vannet fra Okavango-elven ut i Kalahari-ørkenen midt på vinteren, den tørreste tiden på året, og forvandler sanden til et paradis. Se hvordan den utrolige hendelsen gir opphav til et av jordas største naturbegivenheter. Mens vannet sprer seg over deltaet, vandrer elefantfamilier inn fra ørkenen, løver markerer sine revir, skjulte økosystem våkner til live, og krokodiller, fisker, fugler og insekter tilpasser seg elvens framrykning i perfekt samspill. Men mirakelet er flyktig, og overlevelse krever perfekt timing. Fra undervannsverdener skjult under papyrusrøttene til løvenes bakhold på de oversvømte slettene, følg rytmen til en elv som våkner, gir næring og trekker seg tilbake, og etterlater både overflod og tap i sitt kjølvann. Dette er historien om et sted hvor alt avhenger av vann, og hvor paradiset aldri varer evig.

programme.title: Africa's Ghost River
programme.desc: Boteti-elven er et avgjørende vannhull i tørketiden for titusenvis av dyr som er avhengige av det livsviktige vannet der under den årlige vandringen mellom Okavango-deltaet og Makgadikgadi-gresslettene. Når elven plutselig tørker ut i 20 år, må alt liv tilpasse seg virkeligheten med en langvarig tørke.

programme.title: Africa's Ghost River
programme.desc: Ved enden av Spøkelseselven ligger en eldgammel saltslette. Instinktivt søker tusenvis av dyr fra hele Kalahari hit, i håp om å finne et fristed i et av Afrikas største sjansespill, der en unik forvandling kan forvandle støv og død til liv, nesten over natten. Men dette fristedet er sårbart og helt avhengig av den uforutsigbare nedbøren. Blir Nxai Pan en livgivende oase langs Kalaharis store trekkvei i år, eller bli en dødsfelle i støvet?

Skal han en dag bli konge, må han vinne brødrenes respekt og finne sin plass. Akkurat da han endelig blir akseptert, slår tørken til, og det blir kamp om maten. Summer må derfor ta et drastisk valg for å sikre Kios fremtid.

programme.desc: Dyrlegene ved PVS tar seg av en rekke sommersår, fra en marsvin med en abscess til et reinsdyr med en uvanlig skorpe. Ti søte valper får kontrollert helsa og en minihest trenger øyeblikkelig hjelp.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.sub-title: En ny dag, et nytt halsbånd
programme.desc: Det er vinter, og hundevalpene strømmer på. Beinskader, cyster og lange negler gir dem mye å gjøre. Dr. Pol tar også imot flere gårdsdyr, som en angusku, samt en chihuahua. Klinikken tar flere prøver av et reinsdyr, rykker ut for å hjelpe en nedkjølt hest og pleier en katt med forstoppelse. Veterinærene viser at de er klare for alt som måtte komme.

programme.title: Veterinærer i Midtvesten

Klinikken tar flere prøver av et reinsdyr, rykker ut for å hjelpe en nedkjølt hest og pleier en katt med forstoppelse. Veterinærene viser at de er klare for alt som måtte komme.

programme.title: Villdyrenes rike
programme.desc: Etter å ha blitt forvist til utkanten av Savage Kingdom av Marsh Pride, kjemper de tre løvinnene fra Northern Pride for å gjenoppbygge sin én gang mektige familie. Selv om det er vanskelig, forbereder flokken sin hevn og tar tilbake makten.

programme.title: Veterinærer i Midtvesten
programme.desc: Schroeders har det travelt med flyktige pasienter. Dr. Ben behandler en and med en skadet fot, mens Dr. Erin hjelper en bortkommen kylling med å finne et evig hjem. Deretter jobber de sammen for å hjelpe en valp med å komme seg på beina igjen ved å stabilisere benbruddet hans.

programme.title: Villdyrenes rike
programme.desc: På en sandkledd åskam i en øde del av Afrika legger hyenedronningen Zalika planer for å ta hevn på løveflokken som tvang klanen hennes i eksil.

programme.title: Villdyrenes rike
programme.desc: Leoparden Saba er en dyktig jeger som sitter høyt i trærne og søker opp i fjellsiden. I Leopard Rock kan hun gjemme seg i skyggene for å unngå sine rivaler; løvene, hyenene og villhundene. Men tilfluktsstedet blir utfordret, og hennes styrke og utholdenhet settes på prøve da hun skal oppdra to unger på et sted fullt av rovdyr.

programme.title: Villdyrenes rike

programme.title: Villdyrenes rike
programme.desc: Hannløven Sekekama, den ubestridte kongen av Marsh Pride, må kjempe med sine tre eldste sønner som er sultne etter makt. I utkanten av deres territorium vokser Northern Pride, en blodtørstig løvehær som forbereder seg på hevn mot sin svorne fiende. I mellomtiden jobber rikets dødeligste leopardmorder, Saba, utrettelig for å sikre at hennes eneste sønn følger i hennes dødelige fotspor.

programme.title: The Incredible Pol Farm
programme.desc: Det har vært et jordbruksår for familien Pol. Selv om Charles har kommet seg etter skaden, viser gården ingen tegn til å bremse ned! Beth tar neste skritt med biene sine for å øke kolonibestanden og høste honning. Charles og Ben kommer opp med en endelig løsning for sauefjøsets dreneringsproblem. Hele familien kommer sammen for å plante i hagen og feire et vellykket år på gården.

programme.title: Lion
programme.sub-title: Chapter One: A Prince Is Born
programme.desc: Den forsiktige løveungen Kio er sønnen til Summer, dronningen av en mektig flokk. Han blir født inn i en verden der hver lærdom har en pris. En dag skal han kanskje herske over sitt eget rike, men først må han lære å overleve. En tragisk bøffeljakt gir ham et første innblikk i hvor uforutsigbart livet på savannen er. Han blir stadig modigere, og hver utfordring tar ham lenger bort fra flokkens trygghet – helt til et eventyr på egen hånd fører ham rett i veien for flokkens største fiende: bøflene.

programme.title: Kinas skjulte kongeriker
programme.desc: I denne spesialepisoden møter vi noen av de sjeldneste og farligste dyrene som har tilpasset seg livet i Kinas mest ekstreme naturområder. I de avsidesliggende fjellene må rovdyr og åtseletere kjempe hardt for hvert måltid. Høyt oppe i jungelens trekroner bærer en hornfugl familiens framtid i nebbet. I fjellskogene kjemper gylne stumpneseaper om retten til å føre slekten videre, mens farene lurer overalt på de eldgamle gresslettene.

programme.title: Villmarkens utfordringer
programme.desc: På slettene i Serengeti stopper en million gnuer opp så hunnene kan føde unger i en massiv sammenkomst.

programme.title: Villmarkens utfordringer
programme.desc: Når man har alt, hvorfor skulle man gi slipp på det? En forventer at dyr velger den enkleste og sikreste måten for å sikre seg mat, trygghet og ly.

programme.title: Kinas skjulte kongeriker
programme.desc: I Kinas skoger, jungler og høye fjell lever noen av verdens mest besynderlige og vakreste skapninger. I disse skjulte rikene krever kampen for å overleve ofte helt unike tilpasninger. En ung panda får sin første klatreundervisning, fargerike larver viser fram sine iøynefallende mønster, og verdens eneste giftige primat, dovenlorien, sniker seg til et lite måltid. De utrolige historiene gir et sjeldent innblikk i en bemerkelsesverdig verden.

programme.title: Japan's Wild Side
programme.desc: August er en tid preget av forberedelser i Japan. Mens toppredatorer som ussuribjørnen jakter fisk, leter rever og mårhunder etter rester. Samtidig fyller laks og japanske kjempesalamandere elver og bekker med rogn og egg før tiden renner ut. Når store belter av drivis når Japans kyster, fører de med seg den bitende vinterkulden, og fascinerende skapninger som den spøkelsesaktige hvalåten. Med vinteren i anmarsj må ezo-ildere, vandrende sikahjorter, praktfulle japanske traner og verdens største ugleart, nordfiskeuglen, bygge opp matlagrene sine før maten blir knapp og temperaturen synker langt under frysepunktet.

programme.title: Lion
programme.sub-title: Chapter One: A Prince Is Born
programme.desc: Den forsiktige løveungen Kio er sønnen til Summer, dronningen av en mektig flokk. Han blir født inn i en verden der hver lærdom har en pris. programme.title: Lion
programme.sub-title: Chapter Two: A Band Of Brothers
programme.desc: Kio overlever mirakuløst et bøffelangrep, men utfordringene har så vidt begynt. Han er bare tolv uker gammel – den yngste og mest sårbare i flokken. Skal han en dag bli konge, må han vinne brødrenes respekt og finne sin plass. Akkurat da han endelig blir akseptert, slår tørken til, og det blir kamp om maten. Summer må derfor ta et drastisk valg for å sikre Kios fremtid.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Etter en desperat leting gjenforenes Kio og Summer med brødrene, men livet i utkanten av flokkens territorium er nådeløst. Summer sliter med å jakte for de uerfarne sønnene og forberede dem på et liv alene, og kampen for å overleve tærer på. Når et lett bytte blir for fristende, får det konsekvenser som forandrer Kios liv for alltid. Han tvinges til å bli selvstendig lenge før tiden, og nå må Kio og brødrene hans lære å overleve på egen hånd.

programme.title: Lion
programme.desc: Kio og brødrene hans har kommet til en ny og farlig verden. Som den yngste er Kio den mest sårbare. Da de oppdager et frodig våtmarksområde med rikelig med byttedyr og en løvinneflokk, virker det som det perfekte nye hjemmet. Men dette paradiset har allerede sine konger. Et brutalt angrep splitter brødreflokken og tvinger Kio på flukt. Alene og forlatt er sjansene hans for å overleve små, men han finner mot til å rope og gjenforenes med brødrene. Sammen møter de en rekke prøvelser, fra bøffeljakt til kamper med rivaler, og knytter et ubrytelig bånd. Til slutt, som en selvsikker og nesten fullvoksen hannløve, vender Kio tilbake for å utfordre de gamle kongene. Seier sikrer ham et kongerike, en flokk og en ny familie. Nederlag betyr eksil. Vil Kio falle, eller vil han reise seg og endelig innta tronen?

programme.title: Lion
programme.sub-title: Chapter One: A Prince Is Born
programme.desc: Den forsiktige løveungen Kio er sønnen til Summer, dronningen av en mektig flokk. Han blir født inn i en verden der hver lærdom har en pris. programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Under den kalde vinteren i Michigan håndterer Pols klinikk alt fra enkle tilfeller til stygge skader. Dr. Pol og de andre veterinærene bruker spjelking, lim, sting og ekspertise i behandlingen.

programme.title: Den fantastiske dr. Pol
programme.desc: Enten det gjelder kuler, blåmerker, gekkoer eller geiter, så stiller dr. Pol og de andre veterinærene alltid opp. En hund må få hjelp med en stor utvekst i munnen, og dr. Lisa ser til en flokk med høylandsfe. Dr. Pol steller en motvillig gris og behandler en diger grand danois som kan ha problemer med hjertet.

programme.title: Australia's Land Of The Ancients
programme.desc: Vi legger ut på en fascinerende reise gjennom det eldgamle landskapet i det nordøstlige Australia – den mest biologisk mangfoldige regionen på kontinentet. Fra massive saltvannskrokodiller som speider etter sitt neste måltid til pungdyrmødre som beskytter ungene sine, avslører vi hvordan dyr overlever under de tøffe forholdene i et landskap i stadig endring.

programme.title: Wild Lapland
programme.desc: Snøen dekker trærne, og grønt lys danser på en stjernefylt himmel. En kort stund i julen går tankene våre til et vinterparadis, langt oppe i nord. Det er et sted som er best kjent for utenforstående som Lappland, det magiske hjemmet til julenissen. Men langt fra julelysene er nissens hjem enda mer fortryllende enn du kanskje innser.

programme.title: Vinterveiens helter
programme.desc: Hver vinter gjør snøstormer fjellovergangene i Norge til noen av de farligste veiene i Europa og stenger viktige handelsruter. I ekstreme tilfeller skjer det dødsulykker. Det er opp til bergingssjåfører å forhindre katastrofer. De er avhengige av oppfinnsomhet, intelligens og mot for å klare den perfekte redningen og sikre seg nok en lønning.

programme.title: 2. verdenskrig: Helvete under vann
programme.desc: April 1940. Når Hitler sender ut ubåtarmen for å beskytte troppene som invaderer Norge, haster en tysk ubåt mot de dype fjordene mot Narvik, stedet hvor to store, fatale sjøslag fant sted. Mens flere møter med britiske hærskip gir tallrike mål, inkludert slagskipet HMS Warpsite, truer sviktende torpedoer oppdraget deres.

programme.title: Hitlers siste kamp
programme.desc: I juli 1944 etablerer den franske motstandsbevegelsen Maquis en fri fransk republikk på Vercors-massivet i Øst-Frankrike for å støtte de alliertes invasjon i Normandie. Som svar sender nazistene 10 000 tyske soldater fra eliteenheter for å stanse opprøret med alle mulige midler.

programme.title: Mega Marine Machines
programme.desc: To vinddrevne maskiner vil sette fartsrekorder og tøye grensene for fysiske lover og kontroll.

programme.title: 2. verdenskrig: Helvete under vann
programme.desc: September 1944: Kommandør Malcolm Wanklyn på HMS Upholder følger tre ubåter på jakt etter italienske skip som støtter Rommel.

programme.title: 2. verdenskrig: Helvete under vann
programme.desc: Februar 1945: I iskaldt norsk farvann avskjærer HMS Venturer en tysk ubåt på hemmelig oppdrag for å frakte tyske våpen til Japan.

programme.title: Hemmeligheter på havets bunn
programme.desc: Gjennom Al Capone, Lucky Luciano og De fem familiene festet mafiaen grep om USA på begynnelsen av 1900-tallet, men hvor kom makten og pengene fra? Et skipsvrak utenfor New Jersey avslører et kriminelt nettverk, en lastebil i Detroit River beviser at landegrenser ikke stoppet mafiaen og en flytende bar i Chicago viser de tette båndene mellom politikken og underverdenen.

programme.title: Car S.O.S
programme.desc: Denne gangen er Tim og Fuzz i ukjent farvann når de jobber på 28 år gamle Charlies Lexus IS200 for å gjøre den om til en skikkelig driftebil. Charlie er bussjåfør under opplæring, og har alltid drømt om å begynne med drifting. Drømmen gikk dessverre i vasken da ha fikk kreft. Gutta i Car S.O.S får en bratt læringskurve om de skal få dette til.

programme.title: Car S.O.S
programme.desc: Car S.O.S tar på seg å restaurere en Mazda MX5 som skulle vært skrotet. Den tilhører eventkjører Katie, og har stor affeksjonsverdi, da det var en gave fra storesøsteren like før hun gikk bort. Mens Fuzz avdekker mysteriet med hvorfor bilen kjørte utfor veien og avgjør om det er nok bil igjen under rusten, drar Tim til Tyskland for å finne ut hva som gjorde MX5 til verdens bestselgende to-seters sportsbil.
